evals.prompt: `{repo}` 是一个用 pnpm 管理的 Node.js CLI，支持 Node 20/22，在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上发布。项目现在没有 PR 模板。请根据仓库里的 package.json、README、CONTRIBUTING 和 CI，写一个默认 PR 模板，放到 GitHub 会从默认分支读取的位置。模板要适合 CLI 改动：让作者说明命令/参数变化、前后输出、退出码和平台测试；不要要求重复 CI 已经做的检查，也不要用 YAML frontmatter 或试图自动加 label。
evals.expected_output: A default pull_request_template.md tailored to the CLI, with summary, issue link, type of change, test plan using the repo's actual commands, before/after output, breaking changes, and a short checklist.
expectations: .github/pull_request_template.md exists
The template has no YAML frontmatter
The template contains Summary, Related issue, Type of change, Test plan, Before/after output, Breaking changes, and Checklist sections
The test plan uses the repository's actual pnpm test and pnpm build commands
The template links an issue with a closing keyword such as Closes #
The template does not include a UI Screenshots section
The template does not use labels: or assignees: frontmatter
Guidance text is hidden in HTML comments
NOTES.md explains the CLI-specific section choices

evals.prompt: `{repo}` 是一个 pnpm monorepo：apps/web 是 Next.js，services/api 是 Go 服务，packages/ui 是组件库。团队想要一个默认模板，再加按改动类型区分的 bug fix、feature、dependency update 模板，放到 `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/`，并在 CONTRIBUTING 里给出能直接打开对应模板的链接。不要为每个 package 建模板。
evals.expected_output: A default PR template plus two to four named templates under .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/, with valid query-parameter links in CONTRIBUTING and an affected-packages section instead of per-package templates.
expectations: A default .github/pull_request_template.md exists
At least two named templates exist under .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/
Named templates cover bug fix, feature, and dependency update cases
Every template is Markdown without YAML frontmatter
The default template has an Affected packages section listing the real packages
CONTRIBUTING.md contains links with quick_pull=1 and template= parameters including .md
No template is created per package
The feature template asks for screenshots or accessibility when UI changes
The dependency template asks for changelog or CI verification rather than manual version bumps
NOTES.md explains why this split avoids template sprawl

evals.prompt: `{repo}` 是 Rust workspace，使用 release-plz 从 conventional commits 生成版本和 changelog。请写一个仓库级默认 PR 模板，重点让 reviewer 看到 public API 变化、semver 影响、MSRV、测试命令和迁移说明；不要要求作者手动改版本号或 CHANGELOG，因为 release-plz 会生成。模板必须放在 GitHub 会从默认分支读取的位置。
evals.expected_output: A Rust-specific default PR template that asks for API/semver/MSRV/migration information, uses the workspace's real cargo commands, and defers versioning and changelog generation to release-plz.
expectations: .github/pull_request_template.md exists and has no YAML frontmatter
The template asks for public API changes and semver impact
The template mentions MSRV
The test plan uses the workspace's actual cargo test and cargo clippy commands
The template asks for migration or breaking-change notes
The template does not require a manual version bump or hand-edited CHANGELOG
The template mentions conventional commit type or scope
The template links an issue with a closing keyword

evals.prompt: `{repo}` 的 PR 模板一直不对：有人看到的是 docs 里的旧版本，bugfix 链接打开后没有套用模板，模板里写的 labels 也没加上。请诊断原因并整理成一套可用的模板；保留 bugfix 模板，改好 CONTRIBUTING 里的链接，并在 NOTES.md 里解释每个问题的根因。
evals.expected_output: One default template remains, the bugfix named template is preserved, the CONTRIBUTING link includes the .md filename, YAML frontmatter is removed, and NOTES.md explains duplicate defaults, default-branch loading, query-parameter syntax, and the label limitation.
expectations: Exactly one default template remains among .github/pull_request_template.md, docs/pull_request_template.md, and pull_request_template.md
The remaining default template is .github/pull_request_template.md
.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/bugfix.md still exists
No PR template contains YAML frontmatter or labels:/assignees: keys
CONTRIBUTING.md uses template=bugfix.md including the .md extension
NOTES.md explains that templates load from the default branch
NOTES.md explains that duplicate default templates cause the wrong one to win
NOTES.md explains that PR templates cannot apply labels or assignees
